proposed_facts.reason: Canonical response and inline tail confirm facing restoration, integer conversion before the positive guard, converted product assignment, hip-position call arguments, numeric state selection, conditional right-shoulder effects and unconditional three-callback cleanup. Both hit animations confirm positive-value, EMBLEM-only enabled-capsule consumption. The proposal does not equate the stored input with final damage.

Canonical entry functions initialize speciallw.x0 to zero, whereas the response leaves its previous value unchanged when the converted integer fails the guard. State-change arguments confirm states 370/372, zero flags, frame zero and rate one. The effect switch confirms default-kind latch setting without spawning, an already-set latch skips spawning, and cleanup is outside both guards.

contradictions.reason: The two superseded response facts required correction: positivity is tested after conversion to s32, not on the original scalar; a failed guard preserves the previous value rather than guaranteeing zero. Default fighter kinds set the effect latch without spawning. Both proposed replacements resolve these issues.

Accepted deferral for all four non-retained .sdata2 facts: source literals establish numeric uses but cannot establish compiled section membership, pooling, conversion bias, extent, precision, alignment or ordering. No compiled evidence was supplied; unresolved dispositions are appropriate.

Accepted collision-owner deferral: GA_Ground is zero and GA_Air is one, but these callers dispatch to ground conversion on a nonzero result. ft_80081D0C also has an earlier GA_Ground return when ft_80081A00 succeeds. The document preserves this mismatch and exceptional branch rather than treating the rendered ft_CheckGround name as proof.

Accepted lifetime deferral: registration stores shield_hit_cb and copies descriptor geometry, while local response cleanup explicitly clears three different callbacks. Upstream x19A4/facing production and complete callback teardown remain unestablished; neither proposal asserts that local cleanup clears shield_hit_cb.
The documented gravity-evidence locator correction resolves to the canonical ftCommon_Fall definition, which subtracts gravity and clamps downward velocity. No additional override is needed.
